survey_rate_evidence.payer: Bucket owner. Every request was unsigned, so no requester was charged.
survey_rate_evidence.products_per_acquisition_period: every listed product of the 23 tiles, 2015 to 2026
survey_rate_evidence.qualification: Bucket listings on purpose-selected tiles, not national rates or valid pixel observations. An acquisition is a sensing date and platform on one tile. A repeat product of one acquisition, a reprocessed copy or a same-baseline product, counts once here and again in products_per_acquisition. Counts include listed scenes without the full layer set.
